explanation: It was recorded for Distant Drums (1951) and named after Private Wilhelm in The Charge at Feather River (1953). Sound designer Ben Burtt revived it.

claims.text: The Wilhelm scream has been used in hundreds of films, including Star Wars (1977).
The Wilhelm scream was recorded for the film Distant Drums (1951).
The scream is named after Private Wilhelm, a character in The Charge at Feather River (1953).
Sound designer Ben Burtt found the scream in a studio archive and reused it in Star Wars and many later films.
